name: Support Kira/Brennan C
_source: speak;Brennan;You've been staring at that journal again.
speak;Kira;My father wrote it. He was afraid the night Solara crossed the border.
speak;Brennan;Generals are allowed to be afraid.
speak;Kira;Not him. Not the man I knew.
speak;Brennan;People change under pressure. That isn't betrayal.
speak;Kira;No. But it's harder than betrayal would be.
